source: Official Disney sales prospectus PDF (user-provided, 2026-08-08) for Polynesian Villas & Bungalows. Other resorts not yet confirmed against an authoritative source - deliberately left out rather than guessed, see DECISION_FACTORS.md.
note: DVC is a leasehold, not fee-simple ownership - every resort's deeded ownership interest expires on a fixed date, after which the points simply cease to exist. This directly caps how many years of use a purchase is actually buying, which isn't enforced anywhere in the app's amortizationYears input yet.
